name: Wireshark
summary: The world's foremost network protocol analyzer. A packet sniffer and analysis tool that captures network traffic for troubleshooting, analysis, and security evaluation.
highlights: -i — name or idx of interface (def: first non-loopback)
-f — packet filter in libpcap filter syntax
-I — capture in monitor mode, if available
-B — size of kernel buffer in MiB (def: 2MiB)
-D — print list of interfaces and exit

flags.name: --interface
flags.description: name or idx of interface (def: first non-loopback)

flags.name: -f
flags.description: packet filter in libpcap filter syntax

flags.name: --snapshot-length
flags.description: packet snapshot length (def: appropriate maximum)

flags.name: --no-promiscuous-mode
flags.description: don't capture in promiscuous mode

flags.name: --monitor-mode
flags.description: capture in monitor mode, if available

flags.name: --buffer-size
flags.description: size of kernel buffer in MiB (def: 2MiB)

flags.name: --linktype
flags.description: link layer type (def: first appropriate)

flags.name: --list-interfaces
flags.description: print list of interfaces and exit

flags.name: --list-data-link-types
flags.description: print list of link-layer types of iface and exit

flags.name: --list-time-stamp-types
flags.description: print list of timestamp types for iface and exit

flags.name: -k
flags.description: start capturing immediately (def: do nothing)

flags.name: -S
flags.description: update display when new items are captured

flags.name: -l
flags.description: turn on automatic scrolling while -S is in use

flags.name: --update-interval
flags.description: interval between updates with new items, in milliseconds (def: 100ms)

flags.name: -c
flags.description: stop after n items (def: infinite)

flags.name: --read-file
flags.description: set the filename to read from (no pipes or stdin!)

flags.name: --read-filter
flags.description: filter in display filter (wireshark-filter(4)) syntax

flags.name: -n
flags.description: disable all name resolutions (def: all enabled)

flags.name: -N
flags.description: enable specific name resolution(s): "mtndsNvg"

flags.name: --enable-protocol
flags.description: enable dissection of proto_name

flags.name: --disable-protocol
flags.description: disable dissection of proto_name

flags.name: --only-protocols
flags.description: Only enable dissection of these protocols, comma separated. Disable everything else

flags.name: --disable-all-protocols
flags.description: Disable dissection of all protocols

flags.name: --enable-heuristic
flags.description: enable dissection of heuristic protocol

flags.name: --disable-heuristic
flags.description: disable dissection of heuristic protocol

flags.name: -C
flags.description: start with specified configuration profile

flags.name: -H
flags.description: hide the capture info dialog during capture

flags.name: --display-filter
flags.description: start with the given display filter

flags.name: -g
flags.description: go to specified item number after "-r"

flags.name: -J
flags.description: jump to the first item matching the display filter

flags.name: -j
flags.description: search backwards for a matching item after "-J"

flags.name: -z
flags.description: show various statistics, see man page for details

flags.name: -w
flags.description: set the output filename (or '-' for stdout)

flags.name: -F
flags.description: set the output file type; default is pcapng. an empty "-F" option will list the file types.

flags.name: --capture-comment
flags.description: add a capture file comment, if supported

flags.name: --temp-dir
flags.description: write temporary files to this directory (default: /tmp)

flags.name: --log-level
flags.description: sets the active log level ("critical", "warning", etc.)

flags.name: --log-fatal
flags.description: sets level to abort the program ("critical" or "warning")

flags.name: --log-domains
flags.description: comma-separated list of the active log domains

flags.name: --log-fatal-domains
flags.description: list of domains that cause the program to abort

flags.name: --log-debug
flags.description: list of domains with "debug" level

flags.name: --log-noisy
flags.description: list of domains with "noisy" level

flags.name: --log-file
flags.description: file to output messages to (in addition to stderr)

flags.name: --help
flags.description: display this help and exit

flags.name: --version
flags.description: display version info and exit

flags.name: -K
flags.description: keytab file to use for kerberos decryption

flags.name: --display
flags.description: X display to use

flags.name: --fullscreen
flags.description: start Wireshark in full screen
